title: Reconcile the retired US-018 split and close the parent by verification

outcomes.statement: Sprint planning exposes one canonical Anthropic connector outcome: the obsolete US-059 through US-062 readiness offers are retired, and US-018 closes from traceable verification of the already-delivered US-056, US-057, and US-058 evidence without reimplementing their behavior.
outcomes.demo: The four obsolete readiness artifacts fail closed with an explicit CHG-052 supersession reason; US-018 records four timestamped AC verifications mapped to US-056, US-057, and US-058, followed by one build pass and one done event; its rendered timeline has no implementation events and US-019 becomes unblocked.

uncertainties.statement: The readiness schema has no superseded decision even though the four obsolete IDs must stop being offered for execution.
uncertainties.resolution: Represent each retired ID with the schema's fail-closed blocked decision and an unresolved condition that names CHG-052, the delivered replacement stories, and the permanent no-remint rule. This preserves the historical ID while making it non-executable.

uncertainties.statement: US-018 currently describes a 310-minute implementation and would duplicate delivered connector behavior if executed literally.
uncertainties.resolution: Replace its assessment with verification-only work: AC1 cites US-056, AC2 cites US-057, and AC3 plus AC4 cite US-058. No production, test, migration, runtime, or executable-tooling changes are allowed.

uncertainties.statement: A parent closure could overclaim evidence or accidentally run redundant mutation work.
uncertainties.resolution: Verify the child evidence and current build directly, emit exactly four ac_verify events, one build_pass, and one done event with ISO-8601 UTC timestamps, and run no cold campaign unless verification identifies a genuine need; the approved assessment declares zero mutation shards.
